one_line: Hands-only unboxing from every side, with the back cover showing the child's photo and name, on a plain table.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down: hands slide a plastic-wrapped book out of a white MeBook box; the cover shows a cartoon toddler. Voiceover (transcript): "הספרים של מי בוק הם ללא ספק הספרים הכי אהובים על" and the child's name. No text overlay.
q1_hook.why: The product is in hand and moving at once, an unboxing with a cartoon child on the cover (S1, S4, F5), and the voice opens with a personal claim at 0:00 (H1, H4 partly). Nothing is written, so the hook is only heard (H6, T3 not met); the child's name is spoken (S5).

beats.what: Hands slide a plastic-wrapped book from a white MeBook box; the cartoon toddler on the cover
beats.why: Unboxing, the product in hand at once

beats.what: The back cover: the child's round photo, the name, a QR code; then the front cover
beats.why: Shows that the child's own photo and name are printed on it

beats.what: A hand flips through illustrated spreads of the cartoon boy with animals; Hebrew text on the left page
beats.why: Shows the story inside, new picture each page

beats.what: One static take: a hand writes a dedication on the "הספר הקסום מוקדש ל" page
beats.why: A gift use, but 13 s with nothing new

beats.what: Two books on a clear wall shelf under a framed photo
beats.why: Shows the books as room decor

beats.what: Back covers on the shelf: child photos, the name, QR codes
beats.why: The personal details seen again, in a second book

beats.what: Front covers on the shelf, the cartoon boy and a surfing cover "לעלות על הגל"
A toddler on a bed turns the pages of the book

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. The caption offers a 10% code but asks for no comment, save, share or tag.
q2_flow.why: The cover and the back cover come in the first 6 s and the child reading comes last (R4, K8). But 13 s of one writing take and about 11 s of shelf shots add little while the voice repeats benefits (R1, R3), and with no text on screen the benefits live only in the voice.

q3_cta.what: None in the video: the last spoken line (transcript) is "זו המתנה הכי מקורית, אישית ומרגשת שתוכלו להעניק לילדיכם". Caption: "ויש לנו 10% הנחה לאתר!" and a short code that contains the child's name.
q3_cta.why: The only offer, a 10% code, sits in the caption; the video never says or shows it, so a viewer who watches to 0:40 hears no ask (C6). One clear action in the caption (C1), but no comment word or link carries it (C3 not used).

q4_shown.what: Unboxing (0:00); the back cover with the child's photo, name and QR code (0:03, 0:30); a page flip (0:06); a handwritten dedication (0:13 to 0:26); two books on a shelf (0:26 to 0:37); a toddler turning pages (0:37). No price.
q4_shown.why: The printed object is shown from every side, cover, back, inside, shelf, so it feels concrete (K5, F4). The back cover shows the child's real photo and name (S2 partly), but photo and illustrated cover never share a frame. A handwritten dedication shows a gift use (K7). Toddler and name are on screen (S5).

q5_edit.what: 9 shots in 40 s, about 4.5 s each, straight cuts: steady top-down hand shots, one 13 s take of a hand writing, handheld shelf shots with a sideways glide. No text, no subtitles. Ends on a toddler turning pages, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Steady top-down shots keep the product readable, and the child reading comes last with no tail (R4, E8). The 13 s writing take and about 11 s of shelf views are slow, and with no text the voice carries everything (R1, E2, E4).

q6_topic.what: A parent says MeBook's books are her child's favourites and shows the printed book, a handwritten dedication and a shelf, pitched as an original gift. Serves gift buyers.
q6_topic.why: A gift idea with a personal touch, the handwritten dedication, for a clear buyer, a parent or relative (K7, R5). The feeling, the child hears his own name, is only in the voice (S8); the first child reaction comes at 0:37 (K1, K8).

q7_filmed.what: Top-down handheld and propped shots on a white table in soft daylight, a hand with a red pen; a side-angle handheld glide along a clear wall shelf; a high-angle shot of a toddler on a bed in striped light. Hands only until 0:37.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands on the book follow the viewer's own point of view and the cover fills the frame (F5, F4). Soft daylight is clean (F7). The shelf shots are tilted and handheld, and some covers are cut by the frame (F4). Original vertical footage (F1, F3).

q8_text.on_screen: None. No subtitles, headline or sticker from 0:00 to 0:40. The only text is printed on the objects: the MeBook logo, "הספר הקסום מוקדש ל", "הסיפור הקסום של" with the child's name on the back cover, and the cover titles, one of them "לעלות על הגל".
q8_text.caption: "המתנה הכי מקורית ומרגשת!" then "מזכרת לכל החיים!". About 25 words: a gift claim, one technology line, "ויש לנו 10% הנחה לאתר!" and a code. No hashtags, no question, no disclosure words.
q8_text.why: With no text on screen a muted viewer gets only pictures, and the benefits, name, photo, Hebrew and English, local printing, live only in the voice (T1, T2 not met). The caption opens with a gift claim (T7); the offer sits in its last lines, with no hashtags and no disclosure words (T7, T8).

weak_points: No on-screen text; benefits only in the voice; 13 s of writing and about 11 s of shelf shots; the offer only in the caption, a code with the child's name; no disclosure words; no photo beside the cartoon.
lumebook_takeaway: Film hands unboxing, the back cover, a page flip and a dedication on a white table, add large Hebrew text for each benefit, and say the offer in the video.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator or a generic voiceover; the exact wording of the handwritten dedication; music (cannot hear); the exact cover titles (some print is distorted by the angle); whether the two back covers show two children. The transcript's benefits list (Hebrew and English, printing in Israel) is not on screen. No correction to src/coded found.
